name: 0xdeafcafe-tslsp
description: Type-aware TypeScript/JavaScript code intelligence for Claude Code, backed by tsgo.

plugins.name: tslsp
plugins.description: Routes any TS/JS symbol work (find usages, jump-to-def, rename, move file with import rewrites, hover, diagnostics, call hierarchy) through tsgo instead of Grep/Edit/mv. Requires the `tslsp-cli` binary on PATH — install with `npm i -g @0xdeafcafe/tslsp-cli` or run via `npx @0xdeafcafe/tslsp-cli`.
